title: Gende language — Grokipedia
text: Gende belongs to the Trans-New Guinea phylum, more precisely classified within the East New Guinea Highlands stock, the East-Central (Gorokan) family, and the Gende-Isabi branch. [1] [3] This affiliation places it among the diverse Papuan languages of the New Guinea highlands, with close relations to languages like Isabi.
